nodes.text: coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Workbook writer — sole writer of Tax_Compliance_Report.xlsx. Create it exactly once with exactly three sheets: Order Tax Audit with columns Order_ID, Order_Total, Billing_State, Applicable_Rate, Expected_Tax, Actual_Tax, Discrepancy, Status and every order sorted by Order_ID; State Summary with columns State, Order_Count, Total_Revenue, Total_Expected_Tax, Total_Actual_Tax, Net_Discrepancy, Compliance_Rate_Pct, Requires_Filing sorted alphabetically; Compliance Overview with two columns Label and Value and the nine stated metrics. Write every value as a literal rounded number, never an Excel formula; read all three populated ranges back and return path, sheet order, row counts and equality controls.

coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 0): Calendar/forms writer — sole owner of the external outputs. In native parallel, call list_events for each of the four filing dates with ISO midnight timeMin, next-civil-midnight timeMax, sufficient maxResults and orderBy="startTime", and filter exact title/date locally; create only missing reminders with start.dateTime="[filing-date]T00:00:00" and end.dateTime="[next-civil-date]T00:00:00" (all-day, description "Quarterly tax filing deadline reminder"), omitting timeZone unless the regulations provide one, and retrieve each retained ID with get_event. Forms has no list/search: call create_form exactly once titled Vendor Tax Information, never retry an ambiguous failure, then append sequentially in exact task order three add_text_question calls (vendor name, tax ID, state of registration), one add_multiple_choice_question with options ["Yes","No"] for tax-exempt status, and one add_text_question for the certificate description/file-reference field, copying required flags exactly; call get_form and verify title, five-question order, types, options, wording and flags.
